ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the food web diagram shown, if the number of mice decreases, how will the population of snakes likely change?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image is a food web labeled Hawk, Lizard, Grasshopper, Grass, Rabbit, Mouse, and Snake. Mouse is located at the lower right, Snake is located in the lower-left-of-center position, and there is an arrow from Mouse to Snake, indicating that the mouse is a food source for the snake. Reasoning: The question asks how the snake population would change if the number of mice decreased. Because snakes depend on mice as food, a decrease in mice would make the snakes’ food decrease, so the number of snakes would usually also decrease.
